verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export feature. The only exit-related evidence is indirect: Orama ships an open-source library, offers on-prem deployment of Orama Cloud, and says its Cloud and Open Source APIs are designed to be close so projects can migrate in either direction. That points to low lock-in but not to exporting your data. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all project/data-source data, named open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV/Parquet), export of indexes and embeddings, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a clean exit.
